What We Do

Our Core Services

Every surface Vuka touches is prepared, applied, and finished to strict quality standards — whether it's a warehouse slab, a residential driveway, or a feature concrete floor.

01

Concrete Power Floating

Machine-powered trowel finishing of concrete slabs for warehouses, factories, parking decks, and retail floors. Achieves a dense, durable, dust-free surface ideal for heavy foot traffic and forklifts.

  • Industrial warehouse slabs
  • Retail & commercial floors
  • Parking garage decks
  • High-load factory floors
Get a Quote →
02

Polished Concrete

Diamond-ground and sealed concrete surfaces that deliver a high-gloss, low-maintenance finish for modern interiors. The premium alternative to tiles — without grout lines or cracking risk.

  • Residential living areas
  • Showrooms & offices
  • Retail & hospitality spaces
  • Multiple sheen levels: matte to high-gloss
Get a Quote →
03

Exposed Aggregate Concrete

Decorative concrete work where the surface aggregate — stone, pebbles, or glass — is revealed for a textured, slip-resistant, visually distinctive finish. Ideal for driveways, pathways, and outdoor entertainment areas.

  • Residential driveways
  • Garden pathways
  • Pool surrounds
  • Outdoor entertainment decks
Get a Quote →
04

Slab Waterproofing

Crystalline and membrane-based waterproofing systems applied to concrete slabs to prevent moisture ingress, rising damp, and structural water damage. Critical for basements, balconies, rooftop slabs, and wet areas.

  • Roof slab waterproofing
  • Basement moisture barriers
  • Balcony & terrace sealing
  • Wet room slab protection
Get a Quote →
05

Painting & Coatings

Professional interior and exterior painting services using premium South African approved coatings. Full prep, priming, and multi-coat finish. Includes epoxy floor coatings for industrial applications and damp-proof treatments.

  • Interior & exterior walls
  • Epoxy floor coatings
  • Boundary walls & fences
  • Roof painting & sealing
Get a Quote →
06

Paving

Supply and installation of concrete block paving, clay brick paving, and natural stone paving. Proper sub-base preparation, edging, and jointing for a durable, level, and aesthetically superior result.

  • Driveways & parking areas
  • Garden & landscaping paths
  • Commercial forecourts
  • Retaining walls & channels
Get a Quote →

Who We Are

Built on Craftsmanship.
Driven by Precision.

Vuka Construction was founded with a single conviction: that quality surface work requires both the right equipment and the right hands behind it.

Under the direct leadership of Horacio Jose Nhatumbo, Vuka Construction operates across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors — bringing machine-backed precision and hands-on oversight to every project. We do not subcontract core work. Every slab we float, every surface we seal, and every brick we lay is managed by our own trained team.

We carry our own power floating machinery, diamond grinding equipment, and paving tools — which means faster mobilisation, lower costs for clients, and zero third-party delays on site.

Why Clients Choose Vuka

The Vuka Standard

We operate with the discipline of a large contractor and the accountability of an owner-managed business.

01

Site Visits Before Quoting

We don't quote blind. A Vuka team member inspects every site before a price is provided — so there are no costly scope surprises mid-project.

02

Itemised Written Quotations

Every quote is broken down by material, labour, and scope. Clients know exactly what they're paying for before work begins.

03

Correct Mix Designs & Specifications

We use the right concrete mixes and curing compounds for each surface type — not the cheapest option. Long-term performance is built in.

04

Clean, Managed Worksites

Our teams follow a strict worksite protocol — fencing where required, debris cleared daily, and access maintained for other contractors.

05

Direct Communication Line

Call 073 916 2947 and you reach the decision-maker. No call centres. No project managers who don't know your site. Horacio answers directly.

06

Workmanship Guarantee

We stand behind every surface we produce. If a defect arises from our workmanship within the agreed warranty period, we return and fix it. No arguments.
